evidence_grade.A: Direct Nikkei/Nikkei-futures evidence with methods closely matching the proposed module.
evidence_grade.B: Direct Japanese-equity evidence or closely related Nikkei instrument evidence.
evidence_grade.C: Cross-market/general evidence only; requires stronger local confirmation.

data_grade.A: True/official target-market data available under current no-extra-cost and licensing policy.
data_grade.B: High-quality proxy or partially available target data; formal promotion still blocked.
data_grade.C: Key data unavailable, paid, too short, or licensing path unresolved.

literature: Lee et al. 2015 — one-minute OSE/SGX/CME leadership changes over time
modules.internal_result: Proxy pilot shows unstable/nonzero lead-lag and no robust directional alpha. A newly discovered true-CME NKD public intraday sample (2026-03-08 to 2026-04-15) passed technical alignment feasibility against the public Japan225 1m proxy after a DI1 positional-index parser correction: 7,305 common 5m bars, contemporaneous return correlation 0.9222, max absolute correlation at lag 0, rolling 288-bar median correlation 0.9156. This validates CME-side source usability only, not venue leadership or alpha.
modules.forbidden: Fixed NQ/ES/SGX/OSE weights, majority vote, or treating CME/Japan225 alignment as directional alpha
modules.next_evidence_needed: Approved matched-expiry OSE+SGX intraday data with adequate coverage; CME short sample may be retained as a supplemental true-venue input

literature: Asai & McAleer 2017 — Nikkei 225 futures volatility forecasting
Maki & Ota 2020/2021 — Japanese futures/spot realized-semivariance asymmetry
Kunitomo & Sato — SIML realized volatility/covariance with micro-market noise, applied to Nikkei-225 Futures
modules.internal_result: Proxy-method evidence was followed by preregistered true-OSE Mini Stage A PASS (4,442 OOS days; QLIKE improvement +0.0027914, Pboot=1.0; MSE improvement +4.783e-10, Pboot=0.9875) and exact-product JNU Micro Stage B PASS (270 OOS days; both QLIKE and MSE mean improvements positive; MSE Pboot=0.9685). Stage 3 true-target confirmation therefore passes.
modules.admitted_role: Risk/volatility information state only; may be considered for sizing/stop-distance/confidence only after applicable downstream translation/validation.
modules.next_evidence_needed: Complete deferred 1m-vs-5m measurement QA, then preregister any concrete risk-state-to-position mapping before testing. No directional use.

measurement_guardrail.issue: High-frequency realized volatility can be biased by microstructure noise.
measurement_guardrail.frozen_confirmation_default: Use 5-minute returns as primary HAR-RSV construction unless the true-OSE preregistration independently justifies another sampling interval before outcome inspection.
measurement_guardrail.diagnostic: Compare 1m vs 5m RV/RSV stability and, where feasible, a noise-robust realized-volatility estimator as measurement QA only.
measurement_guardrail.rule: Do not choose the sampling interval after seeing predictive performance.

literature: Smales 2026 — CME Nikkei futures; Japanese/English sentiment-source effects
Feng, Fu & Shi 2022 — Japanese news sentiment and volatility states
modules.internal_result: G1-DI1 terminal DATA_INCONCLUSIVE after three logical acquisition attempts; final four-cell panel incomplete with 311 missing cache windows; statistical evaluation not performed.
modules.caveat: GDELT sourcelang is an independent proxy structure, not TRNA replication.
modules.reopen_rule: Do not run a fourth acquisition attempt. Reopen only as a substantively new family with an independently justified, reliable source path and fresh preregistration.

literature: Iwanaga 2026 — prior S&P 500 return vs first/last 30m Nikkei futures returns
modules.internal_result: Direct literature-shaped coefficient signs appear on exact-product JNU (FIRST30 beta negative, LAST30 beta positive), but the preregistered true-JNU OOS information gate fails: H1 Pboot=0.84, H2 mean MSE improvement negative/Pboot=0.454, H3 state-interaction mean MSE improvement negative/Pboot=0.354, Holm fails.
modules.next_evidence_needed: None within this family. Reopen only as substantively new literature-backed family, not parameter rescue.

literature: Li, Endo & Zuo 2010 — Nikkei 225 futures order imbalances explain returns
modules.internal_result: Not tested because no approved free directional trade/order-side history.

direct_evidence_detail.paper: Li, Endo, Zuo & Kishimoto (2010), Order imbalances explain 90% of returns of Nikkei 225 futures
direct_evidence_detail.reported_result: Conventional plus limit-order imbalance explain >90% of intraday Nikkei 225 futures returns in the studied OSE sample; spread scaling raises explanatory power in thinner markets.
direct_evidence_detail.interpretation_guardrail: Contemporaneous/explanatory microstructure evidence is not proof of causal next-bar tradable prediction.
direct_evidence_detail.prohibited_proxy: Do not manufacture order imbalance from OHLC, VWAP or aggregate volume.

literature: Nakamura, Sudo & Sugisaki 2021 — BOJ high-frequency identification uses a 30-minute MPM announcement window (10m before through 20m after).
Finta 2021 — MPM-release intraday response in Nikkei 225 VI / Nikkei 225 VI futures; DOI 10.1016/j.pacfin.2021.101562
modules.internal_result: Stage A remains PASS on 170 OSE Mini events. A DI3 timestamp audit corrected three post-Micro policy-decision records that had inherited 08:50 Summary/Minutes times; the exact-JNU Stage B was rerun on 25 eligible events and remains PASS: mean log(EventRV/BaselineRV)=+1.5965, median=+1.6835, bootstrap P(mean>0)=1.000, 95% CI [1.1366, 2.0633].
modules.admitted_role: Event/risk information state only; not directional alpha. May inform a separately validated entry-blackout/size/stop/confidence rule.
modules.event_source: Official BOJ MPM archive provides exact release dates/times.
modules.guardrail: Do not substitute daily VI, VIX/SKEW, or market-response-inferred timestamps.
modules.next_evidence_needed: Stage-4 translation priority #1: pre-preregister one low-degree-of-freedom entry-blackout rule. Do not reopen Stage-3 windows or use event direction as alpha.
modules.data_integrity_revision: DI3 corrected 2024-07-31 12:56, 2025-01-24 12:23, 2026-06-16 12:19 from BOJ official release pages.

modules.reason: BOJ discontinued new ETF/J-REIT purchases on 2024-03-19.

modules.external_evidence: Peng & Wang 2008 directly reports Nikkei futures 1m momentum and 10m mean reversion.
modules.internal_result: True-OSE Mini Stage A fails overall on 4,170 days. H1 1m momentum is decisively opposite sign (payoff<0, accuracy 40.81%, bootstrap P=0). H2 10m reversion passes strongly, but cannot be isolated post hoc because both cells were preregistered as one family.
modules.next_evidence_needed: None within this family. Reopen only with substantively independent literature/evidence, not by salvaging H2 or flipping H1.

modules.external_evidence: Miwa 2019 directly studies OSE Nikkei 225/TOPIX futures and reports a negative association between overnight return and subsequent morning intraday return.
modules.internal_result: Independent post-2015 true-OSE Mini holdout on 1,857 days is directionally consistent (mean payoff >0, accuracy 54.51%, regression slope negative) but fails the preregistered confidence gate: bootstrap P(mean>0)=0.9208 < 0.95.
modules.next_evidence_needed: None within current family. Reopen only with substantively new independent evidence.

modules.external_evidence: Satoyoshi 2018 OSE report: prior-night USD/JPY change significantly negatively related to following Nikkei 225 futures day return.
modules.internal_result: Strict post-paper true-OSE Mini holdout fails on 1,223 days: payoff negative, accuracy 47.39%, bootstrap P=0.0304, diagnostic slope flips positive.
modules.next_evidence_needed: None within current family; no sign/time/filter/threshold rescue.

modules.external_evidence: Kang 2021 directly studies Nikkei 225 futures and identifies MACD(4,22,3), but after a large external parameter search; only the frozen post-publication holdout has promotion power.
modules.internal_result: True-OSE Mini Stage A fails on 251 post-publication days: mean gross daily strategy return -3.04515e-05, directional accuracy 49.2%, 5-day moving-block bootstrap P(mean>0)=0.5504.
modules.next_evidence_needed: None within this lineage. Do not rescue by MACD retuning, filters, execution changes, sample changes or exact-JNU Stage B.

selection_rule: Prefer high evidence + executable data + non-duplicative role. Proxy consistency can strengthen evidence but cannot satisfy a true-target promotion gate.

local_qros_source_update.guardrail: Do not reconstruct or infer 1m/5m realized variance, intraday path, price discovery, or order imbalance from day/session bars.
